title: Stay safe on Comrades Day: Tips for runners and spectators
claims: The 2026 Comrades Marathon had 21,633 runners, a 12-hour cut-off and about 1.8 km of elevation gain over the Up Run.

Race doctor Dr Jeremy Boulter advised runners to keep replacing fluids and electrolytes throughout the full distance, eat lightly and regularly, and not take painkillers or anti-inflammatories during the race.
The medical red flags listed for runners were dizziness, confusion, nausea, muscle cramps, disorientation, chest pain and sudden chills.
Dr Boulter noted that temperatures often drop steeply after 4pm.
Medical support included medical stations along the route and a finish medical tent, staffed by Netcare 911 paramedics, nurses and doctors.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取 CMA 官方赛前医疗安全博客，抄录 21,633 人、1.8 km 爬升、补液/电解质、避免止痛药、红旗症状与 16:00 后降温。
